> Status: draft. The case/control labels and cutoffs below are examples; match the design to the study.

Input: a gene-level tximport object and sample metadata with `control` and
`case` groups. The main path fits an edgeR model; enrichment and sample scoring
are optional.

## 1. Import tximport counts and align the sample table

```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(qs2)
library(readr)

txi <- qs2::qs_read("input/tximport_gene.qs2")
metadata <- readr::read_tsv("input/sample_metadata.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c("sample_id", "group") %in% names(metadata)))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(metadata$sample_id), !anyDuplicated(rownames(txi$counts)))
stopifnot(setequal(colnames(txi$counts), metadata$sample_id))

txi$counts <- txi$counts[, match(metadata$sample_id, colnames(txi$counts)), drop = FALSE]
gene_ids <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(txi$counts))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(gene_ids))
rownames(txi$counts) <- gene_ids

dge <- edgeR::DGEListFromTximport(txi)
dge$samples$group <- factor(metadata$group, levels = c("control", "case"))
stopifnot(!anyNA(dge$samples$group))
stopifnot(all(c("control", "case") %in% dge$samples$group))
stopifnot(identical(colnames(dge), metadata$sample_id))
design <- stats::model.matrix(~ 0 + group, data = dge$samples)
colnames(design) <- sub("^group", "", colnames(design))
print(design)
```

If version cleanup makes duplicate IDs, stop and resolve the annotation
upstream. Do not silently sum rows with different transcript-to-gene mappings.
`DGEListFromTximport()` requires edgeR 4.10.0 or later and carries tximport
length offsets into the edgeR object ([tximport vignette](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/tximport/inst/doc/tximport.html)).

## 2. Filter, normalize, and inspect samples

```{r}
keep_gene <- edgeR::filterByExpr(dge, design = design)
stopifnot(any(keep_gene))
dge <- dge[keep_gene, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge <- edgeR::normLibSizes(dge, method = "TMMwsp")
logcpm <- edgeR::cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

qc <- data.frame(
  sample_id = colnames(dge),
  group = dge$samples$group,
  library_size = dge$samples$lib.size,
  norm_factor = dge$samples$norm.factors,
  detected_genes = colSums(dge$counts > 0)
)
print(qc)
boxplot(as.data.frame(logcpm), las = 2, ylab = "log2 CPM")
sample_correlation <- stats::cor(logcpm, method = "spearman")
heatmap(sample_correlation, symm = TRUE)
```

The filtered raw counts remain in `dge` for count-model inference. `logcpm` is
for diagnostics and sample-level scores. A QC outlier is a reason to
investigate the sample and library, not an automatic deletion rule.

## 3. Test the declared case-versus-control contrast

```{r}
contrast <- limma::makeContrasts(case - control, levels = design)
fit <- edgeR::glmQLFit(dge, design)
test <- edgeR::glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast)
de_results <- edgeR::topTags(test, n = nrow(dge), sort.by = "PValue")$table
de_results$gene_id <- rownames(de_results)
de_results$reported <- de_results$FDR <= 0.05 & abs(de_results$logFC) >= 1
head(de_results[order(de_results$FDR), ], 20)
```

The `reported` flag uses example cutoffs. Choose thresholds for the study
before interpreting the results.

The sample is the biological replicate. Add pairing, batch, or other
covariates only when justified by the design and replication. Check contrast
direction before interpreting `logFC`.

## 4. Run ranked gene-set enrichment (optional)

This code assumes `gene_id` contains Entrez IDs. Use a deliberate identifier
mapping step when the source IDs differ; retain one ranking value per gene.

```{r}
#| eval: false

ranked <- sign(de_results$logFC) * sqrt(de_results$F)
names(ranked) <- de_results$gene_id
ranked <- sort(ranked, decreasing = TRUE)

go_results <- clusterProfiler::gseGO(
  geneList = ranked,
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType = "ENTREZID",
  ont = "BP",
  minGSSize = 10,
  maxGSSize = 500
)
kegg_results <- clusterProfiler::gseKEGG(
  geneList = ranked,
  organism = "hsa",
  minGSSize = 10,
  maxGSSize = 500
)
dir.create("output", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_tsv(as.data.frame(go_results), "output/gsea_go.tsv")
readr::write_tsv(as.data.frame(kegg_results), "output/gsea_kegg.tsv")
```

Keep the full ranked list. Filtering to significant genes before GSEA changes
the question and discards ranking information.

## 5. Score one directional signature per sample (optional)

The signature TSV has `gene_id` and `direction` columns. The expression input
is the normalized `logcpm` matrix created above.

```{r}
#| eval: false

signature <- readr::read_tsv("input/signature.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)
up_genes <- intersect(signature$gene_id[signature$direction == "UP"], rownames(logcpm))
down_genes <- intersect(signature$gene_id[signature$direction == "DOWN"], rownames(logcpm))
stopifnot(length(up_genes) > 0, length(down_genes) > 0)
rank_data <- singscore::rankGenes(logcpm)
scores <- singscore::simpleScore(rank_data, upSet = up_genes,
                                 downSet = down_genes)
dir.create("output", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_tsv(tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(scores), "sample_id"),
                 "output/singscore.tsv")
```

## 6. Score gene sets per sample with GSVA (optional)

The gene-set TSV has `set_id` and `gene_id` columns. This is sample-level
activity from bulk expression, distinct from cell-level UCell scores.

```{r}
#| eval: false

gene_set_table <- readr::read_tsv("input/gene_sets.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)
gene_sets <- split(gene_set_table$gene_id, gene_set_table$set_id)
gsva_input <- GSVA::gsvaParam(exprData = logcpm, geneSets = gene_sets,
                              kcdf = "Gaussian", minSize = 10, maxSize = 500)
gsva_scores <- GSVA::gsva(gsva_input)
dir.create("output", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_tsv(tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(gsva_scores), "gene_set"),
                 "output/gsva_scores.tsv")
```

## 7. Save the main object and results

```{r}
dir.create("output", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
qs2::qs_save(dge, "output/dge_qc_normalized.qs2")
readr::write_tsv(qc, "output/sample_qc.tsv")
readr::write_tsv(de_results, "output/edgeR_results.tsv")
```

Keep package versions, the design matrix, contrast, ID mapping, and gene-set
source with the analysis record.
